name: ams-centrum-300
note: Central Amsterdam, the canal belt. Dense pre-war fabric, heavy on renovation permits.

name: ams-osdorp-600
note: Osdorp, Nieuw-West: post-war garden-city Amsterdam. Second held-out block, chosen to test whether cls_works generalises off the canal belt. 600 m rather than 300 m because the density is a fifth of the centre's.

name: utr-binnenstad-300
note: Utrecht binnenstad, around the Domtoren. Held out: a method tuned to Amsterdam vocabulary should show a gap here.
